subject.title: feat(xiaomi): expose MiMo V2.5 on pay-as-you-go and default to mimo-v2.5

question: Should OpenClaw change Xiaomi pay-as-you-go and Token Plan fresh onboarding defaults to `mimo-v2.5`, or should this PR be narrowed to catalog-only V2.5 availability?
rationale: The implementation is in the right plugin boundary, but changing provider defaults is an upgrade-sensitive product choice that automation cannot approve from catalog proof alone.

options.title: Sponsor V2.5 Defaults
options.body: Accept this PR's default flip for fresh or no-primary Xiaomi setup and own the user-visible model-choice change.

options.title: Request Catalog-Only Rows
options.body: Keep the pay-as-you-go V2.5 catalog and docs additions while preserving the current Xiaomi defaults.

options.title: Pause Behind Routing Decision
options.body: Hold the PR until the broader Xiaomi V2.5 and multimodal-routing issue settles catalog, modality, and default direction together.

recommendation.title: Sponsor V2.5 Defaults
recommendation.body: Accept this PR's default flip for fresh or no-primary Xiaomi setup and own the user-visible model-choice change.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged Xiaomi Token Plan/V2.5 onboarding and catalog work closest to the default choice changed here.
